gloss: unused but second-hand item; like-new item

definitions.gloss: unused but second-hand item; like-new item
definitions.explanation: A product that has never been used but is sold as second-hand, typically because the packaging was opened, it was a display model, or the original owner never used it before reselling. Common in Japanese resale markets.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{新古品|しんこひん}です。
examples.english: These shoes are unused but second-hand.

examples.japanese: {新古品|しんこひん}なら⟦{新品|しんぴん}→新品：08303_shinpin⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{買|か}える→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: If it's a like-new item, you can buy it cheaper than new.

examples.japanese: フリマ⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{新古品|しんこひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ブランド→ブランド：05221_burando⟧⟦バッグ→バッグ：00008_baggu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけて→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧、⟦{半額|はんがく}→半額：09546_hangaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I found a like-new brand-name bag on a flea market app and got it for half price.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {新|しん} (new) and {古品|こひん} (used item), describing the in-between status of items that are technically second-hand but have never been used. Very common on Japanese auction and flea market sites like メルカリ and ヤフオク.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新古品|しんこひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧ (like-new condition)
- {新古品|しんこひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (to buy a like-new item)
- {新古品|しんこひん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{出品|しゅっぴん}→出品：11726_shuppin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to list as a like-new item)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{新品|しんぴん}→新品：08303_shinpin⟧: brand new — completely new, never sold before
- ⟦{中古品|ちゅうこひん}→中古品：08302_chuukohin⟧: used item — has been used by a previous owner
- {未使用品|みしようひん}: unused item — essentially synonymous but more formal
